title: Study Plan
description: A capacity-bounded allocation of work across one horizon. Proposed until the student accepts it. See docs/04 Planning Engine.md.

status.description: At most one accepted plan per student and horizon. A replaced plan becomes superseded, never rewritten.

supersedes_plan_id.description: The plan this one replaces, preserving the revision lineage.

capacity_minutes.description: Declared availability less the recovery reserve. Scheduled minutes MUST NOT exceed planning.capacity_utilization_max of this value without confirmation.

reserved_revision_minutes.description: Capacity reserved for the Revision Engine's due set before any new coverage is allocated.

objective.description: One observable outcome. Not a topic label.

minutes.description: Estimated focused minutes. MUST be at least planning.min_task_minutes.

status.description: A task with unsatisfied prerequisites is blocked, not skipped.

source.description: Why this task exists. revision_due tasks originate from the Revision Engine and MUST NOT be dropped to fit capacity.

revision_id.description: Present when source is revision_due. Links to schemas/revision.json.

assumptions.description: Bounded assumptions applied where state was missing. Required by Constitution §2 rule 5.

conflicts.description: Trade-offs surfaced to the student. A plan MUST NOT resolve these silently.
